summary: This Tucker Carlson interview extends the Chokepoint Empire and Strategy material-test lenses by giving the March 2026 Iran-war cluster its cleanest no-exit mechanism: war acquires its own logic when ceasefire, Gulf protection, petrodollar demand, cheap energy, geography, and imperial face make stopping harder than the next escalation.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The lens point is specific to the source's main mechanism: stopping the war threatens the larger order that made the war possible.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep this source as the March 20 no-exit formulation already present in the public child page: ceasefire would imply American retreat, Iranian Gulf protection, and damage to the petrodollar system, while continued war threatens cheap energy, Asian manufacturing, Gulf desalination, and limited-operation fantasies.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns dollar reality and debt recycling. Strategy owns the war-exit and energy-board problem that makes the monetary order vulnerable.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization owns the classics as transmissible inner order. Education owns university formation and conformity; Poetry owns living works when the active mechanism is language, memory, and imagination.
